scope: PWA 添加到主屏幕浏览器支持情况
content: Limited availability: This feature is not Baseline because it does not work in some of the most widely-used browsers. Non-standard: This feature is not standardized. The BeforeInstallPromptEvent is the interface of the beforeinstallprompt event fired at the Window object before a user is prompted to 'install' a website to a home screen on mobile.
conclusion: beforeinstallprompt 事件属于非标准且可用性受限特性（主要在 Chromium 系支持），iOS Safari 等不支持该事件，需引导用户通过原生菜单添加到主屏幕。
